# ReplyRecv

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Answers the call in hand (if any), then waits for the next one, in one syscall.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x06` SVC_REPLY | — | yes | 2.0 |

```c
SvcResult ReplyRecv(uint32_t xlen, Handle grant_handle, Handle recv_port, Duration timeout);
```

**Registers:** `(xlen, grant, port, timeout) -> r0 status, r1 marker, r2 length, r3 granted handle`

The usual server loop. Returns like WaitOn() on `recv_port`.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `xlen` | in | Reply length in bytes, at most MSG_BUF_SIZE. |
| `grant_handle` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) (with PERM_TXFR) to copy to the caller, or -1. |
| `recv_port` | in | Port to receive on, with PERM_WAIT. |
| `timeout` | in | Milliseconds to wait, or TIMEOUT_POLL / TIMEOUT_INFINITE. |

## Returns

r0 is the status; r1-r3 as for WaitOn() on a port.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_TIMEOUT`](../errors.md#err_timeout) | No call within `timeout`. |
| [`ERR_OVERFLOW`](../errors.md#err_overflow) | `xlen` is larger than MSG_BUF_SIZE. |
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `recv_port` or `grant_handle` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `recv_port` is not a port. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `recv_port` lacks PERM_WAIT, or `grant_handle` lacks PERM_TXFR. |
| [`ERR_DEAD`](../errors.md#err_dead) | `recv_port` has died. |
